classification.difficultyReason: Read the two labelled points, calculate their gradient, and use one point in point-gradient form before simplifying the equation.

content.prompt: Find the equation of the line shown below.

spec.description: An ascending straight line with two marked, labelled points; both coordinate axes have arrows at both ends. No ticks, numerical axis labels, grid or origin label.
spec.mathematics: The line passes through (-3,-2) and (1,1), giving gradient 3/4 and intercept 1/4. Plot geometry is equation-derived; its equation is not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source-given points and axis labels are visible.
